name: Tillet Custom Fabrication
old_description: Welcome to Tillet Custom Fabrication, your trusted and reliable source for all your metal fabrication needs. I provide quality workmanship and exceptional customer service in the Madison, WI area. Contact me today for a free quote.
about:
Tillet Custom Fabrication operates from Middleton, Wisconsin, serving the greater Madison area. The business is a sole proprietorship run by Gabriel, who presents himself as the primary fabricator and point of contact. No founding year is published on the site.

The shop delivers custom metal fabrication across a wide range of processes: welding (including cast iron and exotic metals), CNC plasma cutting, machining, tube bending, and vacuum‑insulated pipe work for cryogenic liquids. Projects span marine repairs such as pontoon and skeg work, automotive builds like exhausts, manifolds, roll cages and turbo kits, custom railings (ADA‑compliant), furniture, outdoor fixtures, solar panel frames and mounts, beavertail boat pods, trailer repairs and winch mounts. The operation appears to be a small, hands‑on facility; no square‑footage or headcount figures are disclosed.

Customers come from marine, automotive, residential and aerospace sectors. The site lists concrete examples: pontoon railings, custom exhaust systems, stair and ramp railings, tables and benches, bistro light fixtures, cryogenic piping, and aerospace‑grade fabrication. Both one‑off repairs and repeat production runs are implied, though no volume bands are given.

Gabriel emphasizes transparent, upfront pricing with no hidden costs and pledges constant communication until a job is complete. Free quotes are offered on every inquiry. These service commitments are framed as the core differentiators rather than any proprietary technology or certification.
built_on: Transparent, upfront estimates with no hidden fees
